channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 5 new AI, Tech & Research fellowships - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• CISAC (Stanford): AI Fellowships 2026-2027 (Strategic Stability & Geopolitics of AI)
    https://cisac.fsi.stanford.edu/cisac-fellowships#tab-116493
    Center for International Security and Cooperation (CISAC), Stanford FSI · deadline Closed 08 Jun 2026 · Funded in-residence fellowship. Predoctoral fellows receive stipends comparable to the Stanford Graduate Fellowships program, plus CISAC pays non-matriculated student tuition; postdoctoral and junior-faculty/professional fellows receive stipends commensurate with experience and Stanford's established minimums. Specific dollar figures are not published. No application fee.
  • TechCongress: January 2027 Fellowship (Senior Fellows + Congressional Innovation Fellows)
    https://techcongress.forms.fm/january-2027-fellowship/forms/10111
    TechCongress · deadline Closed 25 Jun 2026 · Senior Fellows: $100,600 per year. Congressional Innovation Fellows (early-career): $78,000 annual-equivalent stipend ($6,500/month). Plus health-insurance supplements up to $425/month, relocation assistance up to $2,000, initial-housing reimbursement up to $2,000, travel funds up to $2,000, and a $500 professional-attire allowance. No application fee.
  • Tech, Media & AI Policy Fellow (CMDG, Open Markets Institute)
    https://cmdg.tech/tech-media-ai-policy-fellow
    Center for Media & Digital Governance, Open Markets Institute · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · USD 20 to 25 per hour. Candidates who bring external funding or support that offsets compensation are encouraged to note it; total compensation may be structured accordingly.
  • ZwillGen Fellowship Program 2027-2028 (Technology Law)
    https://www.zwillgen.com/careers/fellowship-program/
    ZwillGen · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Salary USD 115,000 to USD 125,000, with a reduced annual billable target (1,250 hours) to create space for writing, professional development, and policy engagement. No application fee.
  • CHAI: Research Fellowship (Center for Human-Compatible AI, UC Berkeley)
    https://humancompatible.ai/jobs
    Center for Human-Compatible AI (CHAI), UC Berkeley · deadline Rolling / undated · Salary commensurate with qualifications and experience, on UC Berkeley salary scales (negotiated). Funding for two years, renewable up to three given satisfactory performance. Eligible for visa sponsorship, with CHAI also contributing to visa costs for fellows and their dependents. No application fee.
